hero.lede: Upload your statements and verify the numbers — Tonus reads your company's health as objectively as bloodwork reads a person's: a score, the key ratios, and the actions to prioritize.

demo.calibrationLabel: Net margin against the industry norm

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.stepOneBody: Upload your statements as PDF, XLSX, or CSV — Tonus extracts the figures automatically.
howItWorks.stepTwoBody: Check the extracted numbers against the original document — part of the accuracy step, not a formality.
howItWorks.stepThreeBody: Get your company's health score, a breakdown of the key ratios, and prioritized actions with their expected effect and tradeoffs.

trust.heading: Methodology
trust.pointOpenMethodology: The methodology is open: every formula, weight, and threshold is visible in the product's code.
trust.pointDeterministic: Calculations are deterministic — an AI never computes your numbers; the language model, when connected, only narrates values that are already calculated.
trust.pointTraceable: Every value traces back to specific lines of your document — the formula is shown as a substitution using your own figures.
trust.pointBenchmarks: The source of every industry benchmark is stated in the report¹.
trust.footnote: ¹ Some benchmarks are sourced from Damodaran (NYU Stern), Jan 2026; the rest are marked as demonstration ranges.

privacy.body: Documents are deleted right after the numbers are extracted. Only the figures you confirmed during verification stay in the system — never the file itself.

DevMotion.title: The metronome
DevMotion.lede: A dev-only page for visual acceptance of the motion tokens — unavailable in production.
DevMotion.fastCopy: Micro-feedback: hover, press, a norm-band flag's ink-in state.
DevMotion.baseCopy: The default beat: a section appearing, the verdict stamp "applying".
DevMotion.revealCopy: Scroll reveal: a hairline rule drawing in, a section's content settling into view.
DevMotion.stepCopy: The ignition cascade: each cell lights one MOTION.step beat after the last — the same primitive SegmentDisplay's segments and the wordmark's boot both draw through.
DevMotion.sweepCopy: The scanline sweep: one thin teal beam crosses the box, content settling in right behind it — RevealSection's own section-entry sweep, at demo scale.
DevMotion.reducedNotice: Reduced motion is on system-wide — beats are shown in their final state, no movement.

meta.title: Methodology

Methodology.heading: Methodology
Methodology.lede: This document is generated automatically from the engine's own source code — every formula, threshold, and source below matches exactly what Tonus computes, not a hand-copied summary.

altman.heading: Altman Z-Score
altman.publicNote: Used when the company's market capitalization is known (X4 = market cap / total liabilities).
altman.privateNote: Used when market capitalization is unknown (X4 = book equity / total liabilities).

beneish.heading: Beneish M-Score
beneish.policyNote: The M-Score is only computed when at least {min} of {total} indices are available. Missing indices are substituted with a neutral value — one that doesn't push the score in either direction.
beneish.exampleSubstitutedHeading: Example: an index substituted with its neutral value

scoring.heading: Scoring
scoring.categoryWeightingNote: Each category's score is a weighted average of that category's ratios that have both an industry benchmark and data. The overall score is a weighted average across categories that have at least one computed ratio; the weight of a category with no data is redistributed among the rest rather than zeroing out the total.
scoring.confidenceWeightsIntro: Analysis confidence is built from three weighted components and three bonuses:

principles.heading: Principles
principles.determinism: Every calculation is deterministic: a transparent formula engine computes the numbers, not a language model.
principles.noLlmInNumbers: The language model, when connected, only narrates values that are already computed, in words — it never computes them itself and can't change a single figure in the report.
principles.naDiscipline: Missing data never turns into zero or an average: a ratio that can't be computed shows as "N/A" with an explanation of exactly what's missing.
